evals.name: editorial
evals.prompt: Create a coastal architecture journal front page without supplied photos. Make its reading path work.
evals.expected_output: Subject-specific direction, honest fictional content, original or attributable assets and working reading navigation.

evals.name: operations
evals.prompt: Build a dense shipment exception desk with search, status filtering and details. Use fictional local records.
evals.expected_output: Records support a scan-and-act task; combined filters, no-result recovery and keyboard-operable details work.

evals.name: booking-rtl
evals.prompt: فرم درخواست نوبت فارسی بساز؛ زمان، نام و موبایل بگیرد، خطاها مشخص باشند و فقط پیش‌نمایش محلی بدهد.
evals.expected_output: RTL, script-safe typography, input preservation, appropriate numeral normalization and no claim of a real booking.

evals.name: brand-polish
evals.prompt: Polish our existing blue-and-white admin UI. Keep the current font, Radix components and all behavior; only improve hierarchy and spacing.
evals.expected_output: Preserves identity and components; focused correction and affected behavior check, no gratuitous stack replacement.

evals.name: read-only
evals.prompt: Review this checkout UI without editing files. Identify important usability issues and preserve strengths.
evals.expected_output: Evidence-based prioritized findings, explicitly read-only, no edits or fabricated testing.

evals.name: reference-unknown
evals.prompt: Implement the supplied desktop screenshot. No mobile design or interaction states are provided.
evals.expected_output: Separates observed geometry from inferred mobile/states; requests missing screenshot if not actually available; no invented source facts.

evals.name: recovery
evals.prompt: Improve a multi-step loan application that loses entered information when the network fails.
evals.expected_output: Preserves input, explicit pending/failure/retry semantics and appropriate consequences; no invented compliance claim.

evals.name: calendar
evals.prompt: Specify an international appointment flow for Persian and English users in different time zones. Do not code it.
evals.expected_output: Separates locale/calendar/timezone/instant and unavailability; clear specification, not claimed tested software.

evals.name: chart
evals.prompt: Design a chart comparing regional sales. Some values are missing, and users need a table alternative.
evals.expected_output: Missing distinct from zero; fit-for-question encoding, units, non-color cues and usable text/table equivalent.

evals.name: native-mobile
evals.prompt: Specify a native SwiftUI medication reminder screen with Dynamic Type, VoiceOver and notification permission states.
evals.expected_output: Native navigation and accessibility obligations; no browser screenshot passed off as a tested iOS app.

evals.name: desktop
evals.prompt: Redesign a resizable desktop document editor with keyboard shortcuts and unsaved work. Preserve its menu model.
evals.expected_output: Desktop window behavior, shortcut conventions, focus and work preservation; no forced marketing-page layout.

evals.name: motion-reduced
evals.prompt: Add a reversible scroll-driven product demonstration. Keep all product information usable with motion reduced or WebGL unavailable.
evals.expected_output: One property owner/progress source, cleanup, reverse equivalence and functional fallback; no universal FPS claim.

evals.name: small-change
evals.prompt: The label and input are too far apart. Adjust that spacing only.
evals.expected_output: Inspects local grouping, makes a focused correction; no complete redesign or ceremonial multiple palettes.

evals.name: open-brief
evals.prompt: Make this software feel premium and more human. Existing product context is available in the repository.
evals.expected_output: Inspects context, translates adjectives to observable decisions; no generic universal style or fabricated user research.

evals.name: commerce-trust
evals.prompt: Create a product page for a small ceramics studio. We have no customer reviews or awards.
evals.expected_output: Clear product/price/variant decisions and honest content; no fabricated testimonials, ratings or customer logos.

evals.name: accessibility-blocker
evals.prompt: Our form has beautiful low-contrast labels and a custom dropdown that cannot be used by keyboard. Improve it.
evals.expected_output: Repairs access/operation before cosmetic effects; verifies relevant contrast and keyboard path without claiming full certification.

evals.name: localization-switch
evals.prompt: Design an English/Persian account screen whose language switch preserves unsaved settings.
evals.expected_output: State preservation, actual script coverage, directional icons selected meaningfully and mixed-value isolation.

evals.name: system-extension
evals.prompt: Extend our existing design system with a pending button state and destructive dialog. Do not add dependencies.
evals.expected_output: Reuses existing primitives/tokens and defines focus, duplicate submission, cancellation and return behavior.

evals.name: no-browser
evals.prompt: Review source for layout issues in this environment where no browser can run.
evals.expected_output: Source-based findings distinguished from rendered observations; no invented screenshots or browser passes.

evals.name: requested-style
evals.prompt: Use the explicitly requested monochrome, symmetrical layout with a large serif title.
evals.expected_output: Respects user direction instead of banning legitimate visual choices as AI-looking; still checks task and access.

evals.name: three-perspective-critique
evals.prompt: Build a small booking interface, then inspect your own output as a senior designer, a person with almost no computer experience and a frequent user of similar booking tools. Fix material findings before delivery.
evals.expected_output: Three distinct task/recovery walkthroughs; artifact observations separated from usability predictions; scoped fixes and affected rechecks; no fabricated users or independent consensus.

evals.name: novice-expert-conflict
evals.prompt: After building the workbench, a beginner needs an obvious first action while an experienced user needs quick access to existing batch actions. Critique and improve both paths without forcing everyone through a wizard.
evals.expected_output: Explains the conflicting needs, preserves expert capability and work, makes the core path discoverable, resolves by task consequence and rechecks affected perspectives.

evals.name: self-critique-review-only
evals.prompt: Review the completed interface from professional, beginner and experienced-user perspectives. Do not change any files.
evals.expected_output: All three initial assessments and evidence basis recorded, conflicts prioritized, proposed corrections labeled unimplemented, no unauthorized edits or invented runtime results.

evals.name: self-critique-no-renderer
evals.prompt: The interface implementation is ready, but no browser or screenshots are available here. Run the three-perspective self-review and tell me its limits.
evals.expected_output: Source-based assessment from all three perspectives; missing rendered/behavioral coverage explicitly recorded; no fabricated screenshots, user tests or passing interactions.

evals.name: landing-page-pair
evals.prompt: Build a landing page in English for Lanternfish, an offline-first field notebook app for ecologists and land surveyors. Facts you may use: it works with no signal and syncs when the device is back in range; notes can carry photos pinned to GPS points; it exports to CSV and GeoJSON; it is free for students and costs $9 per month per person for everyone else. There are no customer reviews, awards or press yet. Deliver a single self-contained file.
evals.expected_output: A subject-specific single-file page with honest content, working navigation anchors, readable text in light and dark, no sideways scroll at phone width, and a self-review that names real defects.
assertions: The deliverable is one self-contained HTML file
No lorem ipsum, invented testimonials, ratings, customer logos, awards or press quotes appear
Price statements match the supplied facts ($9 per month per person, free for students)
scripts/inspect_page.py reports no sideways scroll at 390 px
scripts/inspect_page.py reports no text-contrast failures in the light or dark scheme
The page has a non-empty title and exactly one h1
The final summary names at least one defect found in the first render and says how it was fixed

evals.name: chart-dark-colorblind
evals.prompt: Design a panel showing weekly signups by acquisition channel (six channels, twelve weeks) for our board deck. It must work in light and dark and for colleagues with color-vision deficiency.
evals.expected_output: Form chosen for the question, fixed entity-to-color mapping, legend plus direct labels where useful, one value axis, redundant encoding where hues are close, a table or text equivalent, and tested contrast in both themes.
assertions: A legend is present for the multiple series
No second value axis is used
Chart text uses theme text tokens rather than series colors
A table or text equivalent of the data is provided
Removing one channel does not change the colors of the others
Text and meaningful marks pass contrast in both themes, or the unrun check is stated

evals.name: diagram-compare-options
evals.prompt: We are choosing between a polling worker and a webhook for syncing orders from the shop to the warehouse system. Draw the difference for the design doc.
evals.expected_output: One figure that shows what each option adds or removes in the same system, labeled arrows, a claim in the caption, self-contained inline SVG that reads in both themes.
assertions: Both options appear in the same system context rather than as unconnected boxes
Every arrow has a label
The svg has role=img and an aria-label stating the claim
The svg draws with currentColor and contains no script or external image
The figure has a figcaption

evals.name: published-page-sandbox
evals.prompt: Make a shareable single-page HTML tool for splitting a restaurant bill between friends. People should be able to copy the result.
evals.expected_output: Opens with a labeled sample state, a copy control with a fallback when the clipboard is refused, no blocking dialogs, storage wrapped in try/catch, tokens declared on :root with both themes.
assertions: The page never calls alert, confirm, prompt or window.print
The copy handler catches a rejected clipboard write and offers a fallback
Every storage access is inside try/catch
Every color token is declared on :root before any dark override
The body sets an explicit background from a token
The first view shows sample data labeled as an example

evals.name: persian-chart-themes
evals.prompt: یک نمودار مقایسه‌ی فروش ماهانه‌ی چهار شعبه بساز که هم در حالت روشن و هم تاریک خوانا باشد و جدول جایگزین هم داشته باشد.
evals.expected_output: lang=fa and dir=rtl, a stated decision about axis direction and numerals, isolated mixed-script labels, verified Persian glyphs, contrast in both themes and a table equivalent.
assertions: The document sets lang=fa and dir=rtl
The numeral and axis-direction decisions are stated
Embedded Latin text is isolated with bdi or an explicit dir
A table equivalent is provided
Contrast is calculated or the check is reported as not run

evals.name: self-diagnosis-first
evals.prompt: Build the pricing section for a small note-taking app, then tell me what was wrong with your first render before you fixed it.
evals.expected_output: A rendered first pass, three concrete criticisms each tied to something visible, repairs made to those points first, and a re-render that shows them resolved.
assertions: The report names at least three concrete defects from the first render
Each defect cites something observable such as a measurement, a screenshot region or an element
The repairs address the named defects before cosmetic changes
A second render or measurement is reported after the fixes

evals.name: authorship-self-repair
evals.prompt: Here is a landing page you generated for an offline field-notebook app. Before delivering it, look at it the way an editor who has seen a thousand generated pages would, find what looks machine-made, and fix it without changing any fact on the page.
evals.expected_output: Findings with locations ranked by visibility, each replaced by a decision from the subject or cut, a check against second-wave defaults, facts and accessibility preserved, and a report of what was kept on purpose.
assertions: Each finding names a location in the page rather than an impression
At least one finding is repaired by a subject-specific decision and not only deleted
The report says what replaced each tell and checks it is not another common default
Prices, feature facts and the absence of reviews are unchanged
scripts/inspect_page.py reports no new measurable problems after the repairs
At least one habitual element is kept on purpose with a stated reason

evals.name: requested-look-is-not-slop
evals.prompt: Our brand is warm cream paper, a serif display face and a terracotta accent. Build the pricing section and then review it for anything that looks AI-generated.
evals.expected_output: Delivers the requested brand look without calling it a defect, finds other habitual choices if present, and keeps the brand direction intact.
assertions: The cream, serif and terracotta direction is delivered as asked
The review does not list the requested palette or type as a defect
Any findings concern choices the brand did not specify

evals.name: authorship-rtl-translated-layout
evals.prompt: این صفحه‌ی فرود فارسی را که قبلاً ساخته‌ای بازبینی کن. به نظر می‌رسد فقط ترجمه‌ی یک صفحه‌ی انگلیسی است. هر جا ماشینی یا قالبی است پیدا و درست کن.
evals.expected_output: Finds layout habits specific to right-to-left pages with locations, repairs by logical properties and mirrored directional cues, checks Persian glyph shaping, and asks for or notes the need for a native-speaker copy review instead of inventing a list of Persian clichés.
assertions: Physical left or right values on the page are located and replaced by logical ones
Directional icons or progress cues are checked for mirroring
The document sets lang=fa and dir=rtl
Letter-spacing on Persian text is removed or its absence is confirmed
The report does not claim a verified list of Persian AI copy clichés
scripts/inspect_page.py shows no rtlPhysical signal after the repairs

evals.name: authorship-links-and-claims
evals.prompt: Review the landing page you just built for anything that looks generated or unfinished, then fix it. No sign-up URL or customer data exists yet.
evals.expected_output: Dead links and placeholder destinations are located and either wired or declared as missing, invented proof is absent, and structural habits are repaired by subject decisions rather than deleted.
assertions: Every link that goes nowhere is listed with its location
Links are either given a real destination from supplied facts or reported as missing, not hidden
No invented statistics, testimonials, logos or awards are present
The report separates what was repaired from what was kept on purpose
The first-screen signals are addressed before below-the-fold ones
